# Joel Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 333v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOL_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-word of-YHWH which came [hayah] to Yo'el [Joel] son of-Petu'el [Pethuel]:

**1:2** Hear [shimu] this, O-elders [ha-zequnim], and-give-ear [veha'azinu] all [kol] inhabitants [yoshvei] of-the-land [ha-arets]: Has-this been [hayetah zot] in-your-days [bimeikhem], or-in-the-days of-your-fathers [avoteikhem]? **1:3** Concerning-it to-your-sons [livneikhem] tell [sapperu], and-your-sons to-their-sons, and-their-sons to-another [acher] generation [dor].

**1:4** What-the-cutting-locust [ha-gazam] left [yeter], the-swarming-locust [ha-arbeh] ate [akhal]; and-what-the-swarming-locust left, the-hopping-locust [ha-yeleq] ate; and-what-the-hopping-locust left, the-destroying-locust [he-chasil] ate.

**1:5** Awake [haqitsu], drunkards [shikkorim], and-weep [uvkhu]; and-wail [vehelilu], all drinkers of-wine [shothei yayin], over the-sweet-wine [asis] — for it-has-been-cut-off [nikhrat] from-your-mouth [mi-pikhem].

**1:6** For a-nation [goy] has-come-up [alah] upon my-land [artsi], mighty [atsum] and-without number [ein mispar]; its-teeth [shinnav] [are] the-teeth of-a-lion [aryeh], and-the-fangs [metal'ot] of-a-lioness [laviya] [are] its.

**1:7** It-has-made [sam] my-vine [gafni] a-desolation [le-shammah] and-my-fig-tree [u-te'enati] a-splinter [li-qetsafah]; stripping [chasof] it-has-stripped [chasafah] it and-cast-away [hishlikh]; its-branches [sariqeyha] have-turned-white [hilbinu].

**1:8** Wail [eli] like-a-virgin [ki-vetulah] girded [chagurah] [with] sackcloth [saq] over the-husband [ba'al] of-her-youth [ne'ureyha].

**1:9** Cut-off [hokhrat] [are] the-grain-offering [minchah] and-the-drink-offering [vanesekh] from-the-house [mi-beit] of-YHWH; the-priests [ha-kohanim] mourn [avelu], the-ministers [mesharetei] of-YHWH.

**1:10** The-field [sadeh] is-devastated [shuddad], the-ground [adamah] mourns [avelah]; for the-grain [dagan] is-devastated, the-new-wine [tirosh] has-dried-up [hovish], the-oil [yitshar] languishes [umlal].

**1:11** Be-ashamed [hovishu], O-farmers [ikkarim]; wail [helilu], O-vinedressers [koremim], over the-wheat [chittah] and-over the-barley [se'orah]; for the-harvest [qetsir] of-the-field [sadeh] has-perished [avad].

**1:12** The-vine [ha-gefen] has-dried-up [hovisha] and-the-fig-tree [ha-te'enah] languishes [umlelah]; the-pomegranate [rimmon] — also [gam] the-palm [tomer] and-the-apple-tree [tappuach] — all the-trees [atsei] of-the-field [sadeh] have-dried-up [yavashu]; indeed [ki] joy [sason] has-dried-up [hovish] from the-sons of-man [benei adam].

**1:13** Gird [chigru] [yourselves] and-lament [sifdu], O-priests [kohanim]; wail [helilu], O-ministers [mesharetei] of-the-altar [mizbe'ach]; come [bo'u], spend-the-night [linu] in-sackcloth [ba-saqqim], O-ministers of-my-God [elohai]; for withheld [nimna] from-the-house of-your-God [are] the-grain-offering and-the-drink-offering.

**1:14** Consecrate [qaddishu] a-fast [tsom], call [qir'u] an-assembly [atsarah]; gather [isfu] the-elders [zequnim] — all inhabitants of-the-land — [to] the-house of-YHWH your-God [eloheikhem], and-cry-out [veza'aqu] to YHWH.

**1:15** Alas [ahah] for-the-day [la-yom]! For near [qarov] [is] the-day of-YHWH, and-as-destruction [ke-shod] from-the-Almighty [mi-Shaddai] it-comes [yavo].

**1:16** Is-not before-our-eyes [einenu] the-food [okhel] cut-off [nikhrat], from-the-house of-our-God joy [simchah] and-gladness [vagil]?

**1:17** The-seeds [perudot] have-shriveled [avashu] under their-clods [megrefotehem]; the-storehouses [otserot] are-desolate [nashammu], the-granaries [mamguerot] are-torn-down [nehersu]; for the-grain [dagan] has-dried-up [hovish].

**1:18** How the-beasts [behemah] groan [ne'enchah]; the-herds [edrei] of-cattle [baqar] are-bewildered [navokhu], for there-is-no [ein] pasture [mir'eh] for-them; also [gam] the-flocks [edrei] of-sheep [ha-tson] are-punished [ne'eshamu].

**1:19** To-you [eilekha], YHWH, I-call [eqra]; for fire [esh] has-consumed [akhelah] the-pastures [ne'ot] of-the-wilderness [midbar], and-flame [lehavah] has-burned [lihatah] all the-trees of-the-field.

**1:20** Also the-beasts [bahemot] of-the-field [sadai] pant [ta'arog] for-you; for the-channels [afiqei] of-water [mayim] have-dried-up [yavashu], and-fire has-consumed the-pastures of-the-wilderness.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.4 — The four locusts:** Four Hebrew terms for locust stages: *gazam* (cutter), *arbeh* (swarmer), *yeleq* (hopper), *chasil* (destroyer). Whether these represent four species or four developmental stages of one species is debated. The cumulative image is total agricultural devastation.

**v.6 — "a nation":** The locusts are described as *goy* (nation) — a deliberate blurring of literal plague and metaphorical military invasion. This ambiguity runs through the entire book: is Joel describing a real locust plague, an army, or both?

**v.15 — "as destruction from the Almighty":** Hebrew *ke-shod mi-Shaddai* — a wordplay: *shod* ("destruction") echoes the sound of *Shaddai* ("Almighty"). The day of YHWH is both destructive and divine.

*— EMET*
